# meshterm-vulnfeed rpmver.match_compare(a, b, rebuild) / meshTerm RpmVersion.matchCompare (review M1, S6): the
# comparison the matcher uses. Shared byte for byte with meshTerm's copy.
# Format: mode<TAB>a<TAB>b<TAB>expected (-1, 0, 1). Every line also holds with a and b swapped and expected negated.
# Two MODULAR builds first compare without the `+<module build id>+<context>` that follows `module[_+]el<major>` and
# any letters, digits and dots (el8.10.0, el9.3.0.z, el8dsrv); when that is equal (the same spec built twice):
# mode `own` (a host against its own vendor's file: RHEL against rhel-*, AlmaLinux against alma-*): the full EVR
#   order decides, module build ids included (a rebuild-only fix is a fix).
# mode `rebuild` (a rebuild host against another vendor's file: Rocky Linux against rhel-*): 0 (the other vendor's
#   ids say nothing, and the feed has no module version to tell a rebuild of the fix from an older build).
# Anything not both modular is the plain EVR order in either mode.
# Real NEVRAs (Red Hat's rhel-8 httpd:2.4, container-tools:rhel8, mariadb:10.3 and nginx fixes, Rocky's
# rockylinux/rockylinux:8 repository on 2026-11-05, Alma's php:8.1 and mailman:2.1) except the made-up contexts
# 0a1b2c3d and aaaaaaaa and the ids 90001.
# Red Hat's buildah, rebuilt with no version or release change and fixed again by RHSA-2024:8038 (Important): a RHEL
# host on the older build IS behind.
own	2:1.33.8-4.module+el8.10.0+22283+6d6d094a	2:1.33.8-4.module+el8.10.0+22346+28c02849	-1
own	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24281+ea10630c.8	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24521+219dcfc5.9	-1
own	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24521+219dcfc5.9	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24521+219dcfc5.9	0
# Alma's own ids decide too: a host on the older php:8.1 build is behind the rebuild.
own	8.1.32-1.module_el9.8.0+300+aaaaaaaa.alma.1	8.1.32-1.module_el9.8.0+326+528679fc.alma.1	-1
own	8.1.32-1.module_el9.8.0+326+528679fc.alma.1	8.1.32-1.module_el9.8.0+326+528679fc	1
# The content before the ids: rpm alone sorts Red Hat's 2019 Judy (el8+2765) above its 8.9 build (2765 > 9), and Alma's
# mailman +26 (.2) below +2601 (.1).
own	0:1.0.5-18.module+el8.9.0+19449+ad5852d3	0:1.0.5-18.module+el8+2765+cfa4f87b	1
own	3:2.1.29-12.module_el8.5.0+26+48d4c9ee.2	3:2.1.29-12.module_el8.5.0+2601+e8845b76.1	1
own	3:2.1.29-12.module_el8.5.0+26+48d4c9ee.2	3:2.1.29-12.module_el8.5.0+2602+327eb9f3.2	-1
own	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+40045+6ce8579b.6	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24521+219dcfc5.9	-1
# Rebuild mode, Rocky against Red Hat. The same buildah spec built twice: equal (not affected).
rebuild	2:1.33.8-4.module+el8.10.0+22283+6d6d094a	2:1.33.8-4.module+el8.10.0+22346+28c02849	0
rebuild	3:2.1.29-12.module_el8.5.0+26+48d4c9ee.2	3:2.1.29-12.module_el8.5.0+2602+327eb9f3.2	0
# Rocky's nodejs:20 is its rebuild of Red Hat's RHSA-2026:8339 fix: equal, not behind.
rebuild	1:20.20.2-1.module+el8.10.0+40175+15dc0b4a	1:20.20.2-1.module+el8.10.0+24197+1602b452	0
# Rocky's current build (id 40402) is not behind Red Hat's latest .9 fix: .13 > .9.
rebuild	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+40402+af9563a3.13	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24521+219dcfc5.9	1
# Rocky's earlier .6 IS behind Red Hat's .9, though its id 40045 sorts above 24521.
rebuild	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+40045+6ce8579b.6	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24521+219dcfc5.9	-1
# Rocky's .5 (id 2061) carries Red Hat's .2 fix (id 22196): not behind it.
rebuild	2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+2061+8d03fdec.5	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+22196+d82931da.2	1
# A rebuild with the same z-stream counter is the same fix.
rebuild	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+40206+be2c8a50.8	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+24281+ea10630c.8	0
rebuild	0:1.15.7-10.module+el8.10.0+40257+286895ef.7	0:1.15.7-10.module+el8.10.0+24521+219dcfc5.7	0
# The release, then the minor release, still order before the counter: 8.10.0 is above 8.9.0 whatever follows.
rebuild	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+40045+6ce8579b.6	0:2.4.37-51.module+el8.6.0+18934+12ac9b89.11	1
rebuild	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+40045+6ce8579b.6	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.9.0+20000+0a1b2c3d.11	1
rebuild	0:2.4.37-56.module+el8.8.0+1456+46b1e3e3.2	0:2.4.37-65.module+el8.10.0+22196+d82931da.2	-1
# Red Hat's z-stream dist (el9.3.0.z) and a layered product's (el8dsrv) lose their tails too.
rebuild	1:1.22.1-5.module+el9.3.0.z+20438+032561a0	1:1.22.1-5.module+el9.3.0.z+90001+0a1b2c3d	0
rebuild	1:1.22.1-5.module+el9.3.0.z+20438+032561a0	1:1.22.1-4.module+el9.3.0.z+90001+0a1b2c3d	1
rebuild	0:1.4.3.31-6.module+el8dsrv+16980+c4b9cd33	0:1.4.3.31-6.module+el8dsrv+90001+0a1b2c3d	0
# Version and epoch first, as always.
rebuild	1:20.20.2-1.module+el8.10.0+40175+15dc0b4a	1:20.19.5-1.module+el8.10.0+23800+0a1b2c3d	1
rebuild	1:10.8.2-1.20.20.2.1.module+el8.10.0+40175+15dc0b4a	0:10.8.2-1.20.20.2.1.module+el8.10.0+23800+0a1b2c3d	1
# Alma's build tail and its .alma suffix (rebuild mode is never used for Alma; the stripping still works).
rebuild	8.1.32-1.module_el9.8.0+326+528679fc.alma.1	8.1.32-1.module_el9.8.0+300+aaaaaaaa.alma.1	0

# Not both modular: the plain order in either mode (the stream rule never compares them anyway).

rebuild	1:3.5.8-2.el9_8	1:3.5.5-2.el9_8	1
